title:
Demons & Evil
or Unclean Spirits
description:
Demon / Demonise / Demonised / Spirits
Greek
Noun: Daimonion and Daimon - Demon also referred to as an unclean or evil spirit.
Pneuma akatharton — unclean spirit Pneuma poneron — evil spirit Pneuma planes — deceiving spirit
Verb: Daimonizomai - to demonise (possess is not appropriate for believers)
Adjective: Daimoniodes - to be demonised (not possessed) Pneumatikos - spiritual
Adverb:
pneumatikōs - spiritually
Hebrew
Noun: shedim (שֵׁדִים) — demons ruach ra'ah (רוּחַ רָעָה) — evil spirit ruach (רוּחַ) in some contexts for a spirit that troubles
